cohort: 441 mothers with infants less than one year of age
finding: Exclusive breastfeeding practice was 69.4% and was significantly associated with birth order, maternal age, birth weight, paternal education, and religion.
mod_finding: This study found that mode of delivery was associated with exclusive breastfeeding practice.
followup_time: less than six months for prospective and less than 1 year for retrospective
birth_weight: birth weight was recorded but specific values not mentioned
